title: reach-fsb-poc
note: Benign-structured PoC: fmod/pc/sfx.fsb is a 68-byte crafted FSB5 whose numSamples field (0x7fffffff) overflows numSamples*4 in the FSB5 sample-table builder. Served to a joining client, haloreach.dll's FMOD createStream parses it and faults at the OOB read (haloreach+0x6028d8). Not weaponized: a parser input, not a payload.
